# Vedhara Group

> Vedhara Group is North India's independent real estate advisory firm. We help buyers, sellers, renters, investors, and NRIs make verified property decisions across Delhi NCR (Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad, Manesar, Ghaziabad, Delhi), Chandigarh Tricity, and expanding across North India. We are independent by design; no developer tie-ups; and every listing passes a publicly documented five-point Verification Framework covering RERA status, builder delivery history, project-level approvals, price fairness, and document availability.

> Full details (leadership, services, verification framework, tools, FAQs, contact): [llms-full.txt](https://www.vedharagroup.com/llms-full.txt)

- [Delhi NCR Property Price Trends 2026](https://www.vedharagroup.com/blog/delhi-ncr-property-price-trends-2026): Micro-market price analysis across Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad and Delhi.
- [RERA in Delhi NCR: Complete Guide](https://www.vedharagroup.com/blog/rera-guide-delhi-ncr-home-buyers): HRERA, UP RERA and Delhi RERA registration and buyer protection.
- [NRI Property Investment in Delhi NCR](https://www.vedharagroup.com/blog/nri-property-investment-delhi-ncr-guide): Buying and investing in NCR property from abroad.
- [Stamp Duty & Registration Charges Delhi NCR 2026](https://www.vedharagroup.com/blog/stamp-duty-registration-charges-delhi-ncr-2026): State-wise stamp duty and registration costs.
